meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Employer-sponsored mental health and wellbeing benefits for the workplace

analysis.summary: Lyra is the only rival publishing at scale, built around manager coaching and AI. Spring Health was almost quiet in the last 30 days, with 1 update and no new pages.

points.text: Lyra added 14 new pages and updated 10, while Spring Health added none and updated 1. [Lyra Health]
Lyra is pushing Manager Coaching with launch news, a landing page and refreshed guides, which looks like a product push.
Talkspace and TELUS each added only 4 pages, so they are weak signals; Modern Health and Calm Business show nothing new. [Talkspace for Business] [TELUS Health (LifeWorks)] [Modern Health]

Spring Health.play: Almost silent: 1 updated how-to on starting therapy, plus a 38-page bulk edit.

Lyra Health.play: Pushes Manager Coaching with launch news, landing page and refreshed guides, plus AI and research pieces.

Modern Health.play: No new or updated pages found; 155 templated /post/ pages sit outside the counts.

Calm Business.play: No pages found in the data, so there is no play to read.

Talkspace for Business.play: Four new guides on behavioral healthcare services, including one comparison page.

TELUS Health (LifeWorks).play: Four new Spanish pages on healthy habits for team wellbeing, all with the same title.

shared.title: Guide-style explainers
shared.text: Lyra (11 how-tos), TELUS (4) and Talkspace (3) lean on explainer pages. Spring Health shows only 1, so it is thin in this format.

gaps.title: Vendor buyer's guide
gaps.text: Only Talkspace has a comparison page, and it targets health plans. No one gives HR leaders a plain way to compare workplace mental health vendors.

gaps.title: Customer proof stories
gaps.text: Only Lyra published case studies (3 this month). Spring Health could show employer results and benefits-leader voices.

gaps.title: Original research
gaps.text: Lyra has just 1 research piece. Nobody else shows research, so Spring Health could own fresh data on workplace mental health.

versus.Lyra Health: Lyra publishes far more, with a clear manager-coaching theme; Spring Health added no new pages and updated 1.
versus.Modern Health: No page data to compare; its 155 /post/ pages are templated, while Spring Health's visible content is one therapy explainer.
versus.Calm Business: The data shows no pages, so there is nothing to compare with Spring Health's content.
versus.Talkspace for Business: Talkspace added 4 guides aimed at health plans and care delivery; Spring Health added none and shows an employee-facing therapy explainer.
versus.TELUS Health (LifeWorks): TELUS added 4 Spanish healthy-habits pages with one repeated title; Spring Health added none and has a single English explainer in view.
